$ go test  # echo
    testdata/between.txtar has update-written sections out of their place.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to put them in place.
    testdata/unsorted.txtar has update-written sections out of their place.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to put them in place.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/between
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/between/echo
    --- FAIL: TestCorpus/unsorted
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/unsorted/echo
FAIL
[exit 1]
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # echo
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/between
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/between/echo
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/unsorted
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/unsorted/echo
PASS
$ cat testdata/unsorted.txtar
The goldens are out of name order.
-- in/do/out/a.txt --
a
-- in/do/out/b.txt --
b
-- out/echo/a.txt --
a
-- out/echo/b.txt --
b
$ cat testdata/between.txtar
A golden sits between two inputs.
-- in/do/out/a.txt --
a
-- in/do/out/b.txt --
b
-- out/echo/a.txt --
a
-- out/echo/b.txt --
b
$ FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test  # echo
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/between
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/between/echo
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/unsorted
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/unsorted/echo
PASS
$ go test  # echo
--- PASS: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/between
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/between/echo
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/unsorted
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/unsorted/echo
